base_model.description: HF model id of the base to fine-tune (Apache-2.0 default).
base_model.title: Base Model

dataset_uri.description: Dataset of (input,output) pairs: local path, HF Hub id, or artifact uri.
dataset_uri.title: Dataset Uri

output_name.description: Name for the produced LoRA adapter.
output_name.title: Output Name

target_modules.description: LoRA target modules. The shipped pipelines pass this as a comma-separated string (`{type: str, default: ""}`, empty = the trainer's default) and the kernel splits it (flow_stages.py `_spec_from_config`), so a string is accepted beside the list.

beta.description: DPO beta (preference-loss strength vs the reference model).
beta.title: Beta

init_adapter_uri.description: Adapter to CONTINUE training from: s3://…/adapter/ or a local dir with adapter_config.json. Empty = fresh adapter. Overrides lora_r/alpha/target_modules (the loaded adapter_config wins).
init_adapter_uri.title: Init Adapter Uri

eval_split.description: Fraction held out for mid-training eval.
eval_split.title: Eval Split

validate_pipeline.description: Validate the whole pipeline on CPU (tiny model, throttled) before GPU.
validate_pipeline.title: Validate Pipeline

save_steps.description: Checkpoint every N steps; resume_from_checkpoint on restart.
save_steps.title: Save Steps

packing.description: Pack multiple short sequences per step for predictable VRAM use.
packing.title: Packing

save_total_limit.description: Keep only the N most-recent checkpoints (0 = unbounded).
save_total_limit.title: Save Total Limit

registered_model_name.description: If set and MLflow is reporting, register the trained adapter as a new version of this MLflow Registered Model (runs:/<run>/adapter). Empty = no registration.
registered_model_name.title: Registered Model Name

hf_repo.description: HF Hub repo id (user/name) for artifact_target=hf; defaults from output_name.
hf_repo.title: Hf Repo

gpu.description: GPU type for the backend (T4, A10G, A100, …).
gpu.title: Gpu

report_to.description: Experiment trackers: mlflow and/or wandb. The kernel also accepts a comma-separated string (a leftover from pre-#1675 plans, which stringified `with:` lists), so a string is accepted beside the list.

tracking_project.description: MLflow experiment / W&B project name (defaults from output_name).
tracking_project.title: Tracking Project

compute_connection.description: Name of the compute.<provider> connection this managed job runs on (e.g. the `cairn connect runpod` connection). Empty = the dispatch-bound compute target, if any.
compute_connection.title: Compute Connection

stub.description: Select the hermetic StubTrainOp (no torch, no spend); CAIRN_TRAIN_STUB is the env equivalent.

ignore_ram_check.description: Real-trainer path only: skip the host-RAM feasibility refusal (#1322). Not a TrainSpec field.
